def parse_atom_site(path):

    for line in open(path):
        t=line.strip()
        if t.startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(t.split(".")[1].split()[0]); continue
        if cols and not reading:
            if t.startswith("#") or t=="" or t.startswith("_") or t.startswith("loop_"): continue
            reading=True
        if reading:
            if t.startswith("#") or t=="": break
            pp=t.split()
            if len(pp)==len(cols): rows.append(pp)

def sasa_atoms(xyz,elems,probe=1.4):
    r=np.array([RAD.get(e.upper(),1.7) for e in elems])+probe
    tr=cKDTree(xyz); out=np.zeros(len(xyz)); mx=r.max()

        out[i]=4*np.pi*r[i]**2*acc.mean()
    return out

def seqalign(s1,s2,go=11.,ge=1.):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); e1=np.array([AAI.get(c,22) for c in s1]); e2=np.array([AAI.get(c,22) for c in s2]); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);M[0,0]=0
    Iy[0,1:]=-go-ge*np.arange(1,m+1); Ix[1:,0]=-go-ge*np.arange(1,n+1)
    ptr=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); jj=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        prev=np.maximum(np.maximum(M[i-1,:-1],Ix[i-1,:-1]),Iy[i-1,:-1])
        M[i,1:]=prev+SM[e1[i-1],e2]
        ptr[i,1:]=np.argmax(np.vstack([M[i-1,:-1],Ix[i-1,:-1],Iy[i-1,:-1]]),0)
        Ix[i,:]=np.maximum(M[i-1,:]-(go+ge),Ix[i-1,:]-ge)
        Iy[i,1:]=np.maximum.accumulate(M[i,:]+ge*jj)[:-1]-go-ge*jj[1:]; Iy[i,0]=NEG
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); mp={}
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0: mp[i]=j; st=int(ptr[i,j]); i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: st=0 if M[i-1,j]-(go+ge)>=Ix[i-1,j]-ge else 1; i-=1
        else: st=0 if M[i,j-1]-(go+ge)>=Iy[i,j-1]-ge else 2; j-=1
    return mp
